main_body: brick and metal kitchen range with chimney
top_band: chimney has no top band (rows 8-20 flat front); metal hood has light grey top edge row 21 and sloped grey face rows 22-25; stove cooking surface at rows 28-34 has light grey frame (rows 28, 34) surrounding dark grey checkered cooktop with two black burner slots (rows 29-33)
evidence: While the stove base (rows 28-47) shows a 7-row top cooking surface (rows 28-34) above a 13-row brick front face with a firebox (rows 35-47), the upper half of the object (chimney rows 8-20) is drawn as a pure front elevation with a flat horizontal cutoff at row 8 and no top surface at all.

style.evidence: The brick chimney and base use repetitive, flat-filled rectangular bricks with only 2-3 tones and no per-brick shading or organic texture. The metal hood (rows 22-25) is a large flat fill of a single dark grey tone bordered by pure black outlines, looking boxy and sticker-like compared to the rich Beodeul references.
